hops.query: foreign currency exchange rate impact on revenue and operating results
hops.rationale: The KO FY2025 filing's Item 7 passages together answer the original goal of foreign currency impact on revenue and operating results. Passage 66 gives the total FX impact on net operating revenues (a 5% decrease in 2024 and 4% in 2023) and on operating income (11% in 2024 and 8% in 2023), plus net FX losses of $180M and $312M. Passage 39 says FX unfavorably impacted consolidated operating income by 11% in 2024, naming the currencies involved. Passage 40 gives segment-level FX effects, and passage 34 includes management's expectation of an unfavorable FX impact on 2025 net operating revenues. Passage 35 notes FX's effect on segment mix. Filing scope is respected (KO, 2025 filing, Item 7); AMZN and other filings were ignored. No requested element is missing.
